items.what: The region was part of Southern Kosal, and is reported to have been under the Mauryan kingdom.
The Sarabhpuriya and Nala kings held the area in turn.
The dynasty ruled from Sirpur. Its most powerful emperor was Mahashivgupt Balarjun, and the widowed queen Vasata built the brick Lakshman temple.

The Kalchuris ruled from Ratanpur for a long period. Accounts differ on who founded Raipur: one credits King Ramachandra, the other his son Brahmdeo Rai, who is said to have named the city after himself.
The Hatkeshwar Mahadev temple on the Kharun river was built in Brahmdeo Rai's time.
After the last Kalchuri ruler, Amarsingh Deo, died, the region passed to the Bhosle kings.
After the death of Raghuji III, the British took the territory from the Bhonsla of Nagpur and made Chhattisgarh a separate commissionery with its headquarters at Raipur.
Chhattisgarh became a separate state on 1 November 2000, with Raipur as its capital.
